subject: RetailCo MAP & evaluation asset exchange: dataset and prompt-pack onboarding
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@retailco.com>, Samir Das <samir@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailCo MAP & evaluation asset exchange: dataset and prompt-pack onboarding

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we’ve scoped a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get RetailCo’s evaluation running on Redwood with a small evaluation dataset + prompt pack and a short test-case suite. The goal is a production-facing acceptance check within ~4 weeks so you can validate latency, quality, and cost.

Attached: RetailCo_MAP_draft.pdf (MAP draft) and asset_provision_template.csv (sample manifest).

High level proposal (please flag anything you want changed):
- Week 0 (this week): sign MAP (DocuSign link included below), confirm security contacts, and deliver 2–3 sample files (anonymized).
- Week 1: Redwood ingests sample dataset into a dedicated evaluation sandbox (ephemeral tenant). We’ll run a small batch of prompt-pack testcases (you provide prompt-pack) and share initial metrics and logs.
- Week 2: Deliver full prompt pack and expanded test-case set; run acceptance sweep and iterate on prompts/model variant as needed.
- Week 4: Acceptance gate (pass/fail criteria below) and move to extended pilot or production plan.

Usage constraints we require for the exchange:
- Assets are provided for evaluation only (ephemeral sandbox). No redistribution outside RetailCo or Redwood evaluation engineers.
- Retention: Redwood will retain artifacts only for the MAP duration + 90 days, after which we will delete (unless we agree in writing).
- No production traffic on the evaluation tenant; token/usage limits will be enforced.

Acceptance gate (example criteria):
- Prompt-pack testcases: >=90% pass rate on functional checks and no regressions on the top 10 priority prompts.
- Performance: 95th pct latency <= 250ms for the configured profile.

Ask from your side:
1) Confirm you’re ok with the usage constraints above (anonymization + 90d retention).
2) Send the sample files (2–3 small records) and your preferred signatory for the MAP.
3) Share SSO/SCIM or security contact for onboarding (we’ll need a technical contact to negotiate the sandbox access).

DocuSign MAP (if you’re ready): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RWI-2345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-RetailCo-eval-assets

Quick note — Marissa will run the evaluation ingestion and Karthik will own the acceptance checklist. I’ll coordinate the MAP and signoff.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: RetailCo_MAP_draft.pdf (PDF, 4 pages), asset_provision_template.csv (CSV, 1 KB)

From: Elena Park <elena@retailco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Das <samir@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo MAP & evaluation asset exchange: dataset and prompt-pack onboarding

Hi Irene —

Thanks, this looks good and clear. A few quick questions before we loop in procurement: 

1) Anonymization: our datasets include store IDs and timestamps. Do you have a recommended minimal schema (we prefer to provide an already-masked sample)? Is there a template we should follow?

2) Retention: 90 days is acceptable, but can we request a 30-day review window prior to deletion for internal audit?

3) Security: who is our technical contact for SSO and the sandbox network configuration? Also, do you support per-customer KMS keys for the sandbox buckets?

If those items look good, I’ll send the two sample files today and route the MAP to our legal team for signature.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Data Science, RetailCo
elena@retailco.com
(212) 555-0199

On Mon, Sep 15, 2025 at 10:12 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo MAP & evaluation asset exchange: dataset and prompt-pack onboarding

Elena —

Great questions, thanks. Short answers first, details below.

1) Anonymization template: we’ve attached a small CSV template that strips store IDs to a pseudonymized token, removes customer identifiers, and keeps minimal temporal context (day-level only). See attached asset_provision_template.csv for the minimal fields. For onboarding, please send a 2–3 record sample that follows that template.

2) Retention window: we can do a 30-day internal review hold followed by deletion at 90 days. To be explicit: Redwood will mark artifacts for deletion at day 60 and run deletion on day 90 unless you request an extension in writing during the 30-day review window.

3) KMS & sandbox: we support customer-managed KMS keys for storage in the evaluation sandbox (optional). For SSO/SCIM, please provide your IdP metadata and the technical contact. Our sandbox will be a network-isolated tenant; we’ll provide a minimal firewall ACL list once we have the IPs.

Proposed MAP milestones (I pulled these into a simple timeline sheet — attached MAP_timeline_sheet.xlsx):
- 2025-09-16: RetailCo sends 2 sample records and security contact (you indicated samples today).
- 2025-09-18: Redwood ingests samples, provides initial ingestion report + anonymization check.
- 2025-09-22: RetailCo provides full prompt-pack + test-case manifest.
- 2025-09-26: Redwood runs acceptance sweep & shares results.
- 2025-10-01: Acceptance gate / decision to proceed to pilot.

Acceptance criteria (restated):
- Functional pass-rate >= 90% on agreed testcases.
- No critical security findings from our sandbox scan.
- Operational: throughput and 95th pct latency in line with the profile we discussed.

Next steps for you:
- Send sample files (following the CSV template) and security contact.
- Have legal review the MAP draft — DocuSign link is the fastest route.

Attachment: MAP_timeline_sheet.xlsx (XLSX, single sheet).

I’ll stand by for the samples and legal contact. Marissa — I’ve assigned you the ingestion tasks for 9/18; Karthik, please prep the acceptance checklist and test-case harness.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clarifications and the timeline sheet. Legal is OK with the 30/90 retention flow. We’ve attached our security contact list for the sandbox (RetailCo_Security_Control_Contacts.pdf) — Anika Rao will own the SSO work.

We’ll sign the MAP via DocuSign today and Elena (me) will be the legal signatory. Please proceed with the sample ingestion when you receive the files (I’ll send them now in a separate email).

Thanks,
